Components of the perspective denominator gradient vector $\mathbf{d}$.
Determine the screen-space bounding box of the surfel.
Compute the center of this bounding box, $(x_c, y_c)$.
Compute the Jacobian $\mathbf{J}$ and the denominator gradient $\mathbf{d}$ at the center.
This involves evaluating the partial derivatives of the rational function.
Store the eight coefficients: $(u_0, v_0)$, $\mathbf{J}$, and $\mathbf{d}$.
Calculate the pixel offset from the center: $\Delta = (x - x_c, y - y_c)$.
Compute the perspective denominator: $denom = 1 + \mathbf{d}^{\top}\Delta$.
**Edge Case/Pitfall:** If $denom \le 0$, the plane is parallel to or behind the camera for this pixel.
